tools.name: cancel_workflow
tools.description: Cancel a running workflow. You can only cancel workflows you own.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run several workflow steps together, in the consumer API format, and return their outputs. Get each step's input shape from get_input_schema; for a single step use run_step. Steps run in order unless independent; a later step can take an earlier step's output with {"$ref":"<step name>","path":"output.images[0].url"} in place of a value.

steps.description: Array of steps: {"$type": the stepType from get_input_schema, "input": {...}, "name": optional label other steps use in $ref}. A {"steps": [...]} object is accepted too.

whatif.description: Price the workflow without running it or spending Buzz

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for completion (default true, except for training). Set false to get the workflow ID immediately.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags (1-200 characters each) to attach to the workflow

metadataJson.description: JSON object stored as the workflow's metadata

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Get a workflow's status and each step's status and output by its ID, with resource links to any files produced. You can only view workflows you own.

workflowId.description: The workflow ID to look up

tools.name: run_step
tools.description: Run one step: an image, video, speech, music, upscale, conversion, tagging or any other service. Pass stepType and input as get_input_schema returns them, with input completed within its schema; the input carries everything, including the prompt. For several steps chained together use run_workflow. Returns the step's output with resource links to any files it produced.

stepType.description: Step type from get_input_schema, e.g. imageGen, videoGen, textToSpeech, imageUpscaler

input.description: The stepType's input, matching the schema from get_input_schema

whatif.description: Price the request without running it or spending Buzz

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for completion (default true, except for training). Set false to get the workflow ID immediately.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags (1-200 characters each) to attach to the workflow

metadataJson.description: JSON object stored as the workflow's metadata

tools.name: get_input_schema
tools.description: Get the JSON Schema and an example input for a service (one concrete thing a workflow step can do, e.g. image/comfy/sdxl/createImage) to use with run_step or run_workflow. Pass the service id find_services returns, or browse: stepType alone lists that step's choices, parameters narrows them. Omit everything to list the step types.

service.description: Service id as find_services returns it, e.g. image/flux2/klein/createImage. Sets stepType and parameters.

stepType.description: Step type, e.g. imageGen, videoGen, textToSpeech, convertImage.

parameters.description: Service parameters to narrow by: engine, then ecosystem/model/version/provider, then operation, e.g. {"engine":"comfy","ecosystem":"sdxl"}.

resources.description: imageGen only: Civitai checkpoint and/or LoRA AIRs, e.g. urn:air:sdxl:lora:civitai:476872@530000. They must share one ecosystem, which picks the service; the example has them filled in. parameters may still set operation and model.

tools.name: caption_media
tools.description: Generate a descriptive caption for an image or video. Useful for understanding media content before processing.

mediaUrl.description: URL of the image or video to caption

maxNewTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Default: 300

whatif.description: Price the request without running it or spending Buzz

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for completion (default true). Set false to get the workflow ID immediately.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags (1-200 characters each) to attach to the workflow

metadataJson.description: JSON object stored as the workflow's metadata

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get the plan for a multi-step job before starting it: generating with specific Civitai models, turning an image into a video, editing an image, comparing services, or working out what media contains.

topic.description: civitai_models, image_to_video, edit_image, compare_services or understand_media

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List your recent workflows. Returns workflow IDs, status, step types, cost, and timing.

take.description: Maximum number of workflows to return (default 10, max 50)

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe audio/video to text with optional word-level timestamps.

mediaUrl.description: URL of the audio/video to transcribe

whatif.description: Price the request without running it or spending Buzz

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for completion (default true). Set false to get the workflow ID immediately.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags (1-200 characters each) to attach to the workflow

metadataJson.description: JSON object stored as the workflow's metadata

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Find and compare services (one concrete engine, model and operation, e.g. image/flux2/klein/createImage/9b) by speed, cost and success rate, plus OpenRouter chat models, which run as the chatCompletion step. Takes plain language like 'a watercolor fox', 'fast cheap anime image' or 'best video'. Pass a result's service id to get_input_schema.

query.description: What you want in plain words ('a watercolor fox', 'fast cheap anime image', 'upscale a video'), a name ('flux', 'claude'), or an exact service id ('image/flux1-kontext/pro'). Omit it, or pass '*', to list a category.

category.description: Filter by category: image, video, audio, chat

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)
